searchText: <@427491045308235776> won't tell. He just promised me something good and "committed" to it by giving me the hash of whatever "something good" is. I guess you can think of it as a wrapped box. Kev promises what is inside the box is good, but I cannot open the box yet. Maybe the box is empty, or maybe Key will never give me the ability to unwrap it. Or maybe it contains a billion dollars. 🤷 big if true This is the conundrum of presents, one does not actually know if they are interesting/good or not until after they are opened. You can only speculate.
